title: OrbitDesk Personal 1.0.1
summary: Adds the accepted Guided Project Update workflow and reliable Copy Prompt behavior for end-of-session project handoffs.
highlights: Create a project-specific AI handoff prompt from Project Detail
Paste and parse accomplished work, current state, next action, tasks, blocker, and decision
Review and edit every parsed field before saving
Save Work History and project tasks with duplicate-task prevention
Reliable desktop Copy Prompt confirmation and truthful fallback
Personal and Corporate guided-update modules remain isolated
